sentences.en: Nationalism is an infantile disease. It is the measles of mankind.
sentences.zh: 民族主义是一种幼稚病。它是人类的麻疹。

sentences.en: Algerian Arabs mask their hatred of the Kabyle by hypocritical nationalism.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚阿拉伯人用虚伪的民族主义掩饰他们对卡比尔人的仇恨。

sentences.en: As Magyarization grew stricter, Slovak nationalism continued to blossom.
sentences.zh: 随着匈牙利化政策变得越来越严格，斯洛伐克民族主义继续蓬勃发展。

senses.zh: 爱国主义，爱国心,民族主义,国家主义,民族特性
